Hero.description: Hello, I am Clinical Psychologist Gökçe Toluç Saklı. I offer evidence-based online psychotherapy to adults, children, and adolescents globally from the US.

About.titlePrefix: Who is Clinical Psychologist <green>Gökçe TOLUÇ SAKLI</green>?
About.p1: Gökçe Toluç Saklı serves as an adult, child, and adolescent therapist. After graduating with honors from Beykent University's Psychology department in 2014, she completed her Master's degree in Clinical Psychology at Istanbul Gelişim University to earn her specialization.
About.p2: During her training, she gained clinical experience at Bakırköy Mazhar Osman and Beylikdüzü State Hospital psychiatry departments. Between 2018 and 2025, she worked as a Clinical Psychologist at private clinics in Bakırköy, Suadiye, and Beylikdüzü. After working as a child and family psychologist at various institutions, she served as a Clinical Psychologist at Çatalca Municipality for 4 years.
About.p3: In addition to her expertise in Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and Schema Therapy, she enriched her clinical practice by completing Human Resources Specialization at Bahçeşehir University in 2022 and Art Therapy training at Istanbul University in 2023. In early August 2025, she presented her oral paper titled 'The Regulatory Effect of Sociodemographic Variables on the Relationship between Communication Skills and Social Anxiety in Young Adulthood' at the 12th International Paris Congress on Social Sciences and Humanities. She currently provides online therapy to clients worldwide from the United States.
About.card1Desc: Years of extensive clinical experience covering Bakırköy Mazhar Osman Hospital, private clinics, and Çatalca Municipality.
About.card2Desc: Honors degree, Master's in Clinical Psychology, CBT and Schema Therapy expertise, and Paris Congress paper.
About.card3Desc: Uninterrupted online therapy for adults, children, and adolescents worldwide, provided from the United States.

Services.title: Services & Expertise
Services.description: My primary areas of expertise include anxiety, social phobia, depression, OCD, trauma, and relationship dynamics.
Services.s1Desc: Professional support in individual processes using CBT-focused approaches to overcome emotional and cognitive challenges.
Services.s2Desc: Development-oriented therapy support for the emotional processes of children and youth, including family participation.
Services.s3Desc: Guidance service for communication issues in relationships, trust building, and healthy bonding processes.
Services.s4Desc: The opportunity to attend uninterrupted professional therapy sessions from your own safe space, globally from the US.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.description: Here you can find answers to basic questions about the therapy process.
FAQ.q1: How long do the sessions last?
FAQ.a1: Our individual therapy sessions standardly last for 50 minutes.
FAQ.q2: Is online therapy as effective as in-person therapy?
FAQ.a2: Yes, scientific research shows that online therapy is as effective as in-person therapy in many cases.
FAQ.q3: How long should I continue therapy?
FAQ.a3: The therapy process varies completely based on individual needs.
FAQ.q4: How does the privacy policy work?
FAQ.a4: Due to ethical rules, all information you share is kept strictly confidential.

Quote.text: The courage to meet your own darkness in a safe space is where healing begins.
Quote.author: Gökçe Toluç Saklı, MSc
